# ============================================================================== # PROTOTIPE SHINY VDP — CERITA DATA PARTISIPASI PENDIDIKAN ANTARPROVINSI 2015–2025 # "Sudah Sejauh Mana Anak Indonesia Bersekolah?" untuk publik awam # Data : data/app_VDP.rds (dibuat 03_VDP/script/03_siapkan_shiny_VDP.R) # Paket : shiny, bslib, ggplot2, plotly, leaflet, ggiraph — semuanya ada di webR (shinylive) # highcharter TIDAK dipakai: dependensinya (XML) tidak tersedia di webR; grafik dinamis # (range slider) dibuat dengan plotly. # Visual : fungsi/00_visual_system.R & label_variabel_VDP.R (salinan otomatis, jangan diedit di sini) # Jalankan lokal: shiny::runApp("D:/R/DATA SAINS (TUGAS AKHIR)/03_VDP/shiny/app") # ============================================================================== library(shiny) library(bslib) library(ggplot2) library(plotly) library(leaflet) perlu <- c(file.path("fungsi", c("00_visual_system.R", "label_variabel_VDP.R", "teks_VDP.R")), file.path("data", "app_VDP.rds"), file.path("www", "gerak_provinsi.gif")) if (!all(file.exists(perlu))) stop("File aplikasi belum lengkap (", paste(perlu[!file.exists(perlu)], collapse = ", "), "). Jalankan dulu 03_VDP/script/03_siapkan_shiny_VDP.R.", call. = FALSE) for (f in perlu[1:3]) source(f, encoding = "UTF-8") if (!exists("warna_teks") || !exists("BENTUK_PAPUA")) stop("fungsi/label_variabel_VDP.R masih versi lama (sebelum audit desain 17 Nov). ", "Jalankan ulang 03_VDP/script/03_siapkan_shiny_VDP.R.", call. = FALSE) D <- readRDS(file.path("data", "app_VDP.rds")) P <- D$panel NAS <- P[P$nasional, ] PROV <- P[!P$nasional, ] NAMA_PROV <- sort(D$provinsi$nama) V_APS <- c("APS_07_12", "APS_13_15", "APS_16_18", "APS_19_23") V_APM <- c("APM_SD", "APM_SMP", "APM_SM") V_APK <- c("APK_SD", "APK_SMP", "APK_SM") V_NET <- c("NET_KOTA", "NET_DESA", "NET_TOTAL") FONT_WEB <- "Segoe UI, Calibri, Arial, sans-serif" BASE_APP <- 12 TB <- teks_bab(D) REK <- teks_rekomendasi(D) INDUK <- c(`93` = 91, `94` = 91, `95` = 91, `96` = 92) # provinsi pemekaran 2022 -> induk # ggiraph dipakai bila tersedia & berfungsi; bila tidak (mis. masalah font di peramban), # grafik yang sama ditampilkan statis sehingga aplikasi tetap berjalan. ADA_GIRAFE <- requireNamespace("ggiraph", quietly = TRUE) && isTRUE(tryCatch({ ggiraph::girafe(ggobj = ggplot() + geom_point(aes(1, 1))); TRUE }, error = function(e) FALSE)) catatan <- function(...) tags$p(class = "small text-muted mb-0", ...) istilah <- function(kata, arti) tooltip(tags$span(class = "istilah", kata), arti) tint <- function(col, t = 0.85) grDevices::colorRampPalette(c(col, "#FFFFFF"))(101)[round(t * 100) + 1] pct <- function(x, d = 1) ifelse(is.na(x), "tidak ada data", paste0(fmt_angka(x, d), "%")) nilai_prov <- function(nama, v, th) { x <- PROV[[v]][PROV$nama == nama & PROV$tahun == th]; if (length(x)) x else NA } nilai_nas <- function(v, th) NAS[[v]][NAS$tahun == th] # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ # Data peta & peringkat # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ # Tahun dengan cakupan lama: wilayah provinsi pemekaran diwarnai dengan angka provinsi induk # (wilayah lama induk memang mencakup daerah itu), dan diberi keterangan. data_peta <- function(v, th) { d <- PROV[PROV$tahun == th, c("kode", "nama", v, "CAKUPAN_LAMA_PEND", "CAKUPAN_LAMA_NET")] names(d)[3] <- "nilai" lama <- if (v %in% V_NET) d$CAKUPAN_LAMA_NET else d$CAKUPAN_LAMA_PEND d$catatan <- ""; d$salinan <- FALSE if (any(lama)) { for (k in names(INDUK)) { i <- d$kode == as.numeric(k); j <- d$kode == INDUK[[k]] d$nilai[i] <- d$nilai[j]; d$salinan[i] <- TRUE d$catatan[i] <- paste0("Belum menjadi provinsi sendiri; angka = ", d$nama[j], " (wilayah lama)") } d$catatan[d$kode %in% c(91, 92)] <- "Wilayah lama (sebelum pemekaran 2022), lebih luas dari sekarang" } ind <- nilai_nas(v, th) d$indonesia <- ind d$selisih <- d$nilai - ind d$label <- paste0("", d$nama, "
", ifelse(is.na(d$nilai), "Tidak ada data", paste0(fmt_angka(d$nilai, 1), "% · Indonesia ", fmt_angka(ind, 1), "%")), ifelse(nzchar(d$catatan), paste0("
", d$catatan, ""), "")) d } peta_selisih <- function(v, th, sorot = "") { d <- data_peta(v, th); lim <- D$lim[[v]] pal <- colorNumeric(c(DIV_RENDAH, DIV_TENGAH, DIV_TINGGI), domain = c(-lim, lim), na.color = COL[["abu_muda"]]) i <- match(D$peta$kode, d$kode) pilih <- nzchar(sorot) & D$peta$nama == sorot leaflet(options = leafletOptions(zoomSnap = 0.25, minZoom = 2.5, attributionControl = FALSE)) |> addPolygons(data = cbind(D$peta$lng, D$peta$lat), fillColor = pal(pmax(pmin(d$selisih[i], lim), -lim)), fillOpacity = 0.92, # audit 17 Nov: batas abu-abu (bukan putih) agar provinsi yang dekat angka Indonesia # (warnanya hampir putih) tetap terlihat bentuknya color = ifelse(pilih, COL[["hitam"]], COL[["abu"]]), weight = ifelse(pilih, 2.5, 0.5), label = lapply(d$label[i], htmltools::HTML), labelOptions = labelOptions(style = list("font-family" = FONT_WEB, "font-size" = "13px")), highlightOptions = highlightOptions(weight = 2, color = COL[["hitam"]], bringToFront = TRUE)) |> fitBounds(95, -11, 141, 6) } # Legenda peta di bawah peta (audit 17 Nov: legenda bawaan leaflet menutupi pulau di layar HP) legenda_selisih <- function(lim) { grad <- paste0("linear-gradient(to right,", DIV_RENDAH, ",", DIV_TENGAH, ",", DIV_TINGGI, ")") tags$div(class = "legenda-peta", tags$div(class = "small fw-semibold mb-1", "Selisih dari angka Indonesia (poin persen)"), tags$div(style = paste0("height:12px;border-radius:2px;opacity:.92;background:", grad)), tags$div(class = "d-flex justify-content-between small", tags$span(paste0("−", lim)), tags$span("0"), tags$span(paste0("+", lim))), tags$div(class = "d-flex justify-content-between small text-muted", tags$span("◀ di bawah Indonesia"), tags$span("di atas Indonesia ▶"))) } # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ # Grafik ggplot (+ ggiraph): fungsi murni # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ geom_tile_i <- function(...) if (ADA_GIRAFE) ggiraph::geom_tile_interactive(...) else geom_tile(...) geom_point_i <- function(...) if (ADA_GIRAFE) ggiraph::geom_point_interactive(...) else geom_point(...) # sempit = layar HP (wadah < 540 px): panel disusun 2 kolom agar kotak & teks tetap terbaca gg_waffle <- function(prov = "", sempit = FALSE) { wil <- data.frame(wilayah = "Indonesia", var = V_APS, n = round(unlist(NAS[NAS$tahun == 2025, V_APS]))) if (nzchar(prov)) wil <- rbind(wil, data.frame(wilayah = prov, var = V_APS, n = round(unlist(PROV[PROV$nama == prov & PROV$tahun == 2025, V_APS])))) w <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(wil)), function(i) data.frame(wilayah = wil$wilayah[i], var = wil$var[i], n = wil$n[i], k = 1:100))) w$x <- (w$k - 1) %% 10; w$y <- (w$k - 1) %/% 10 w$status <- factor(ifelse(w$k <= w$n, "Bersekolah", "Tidak bersekolah"), levels = names(COL_SEKOLAH)) # di HP label panel dipendekkan ("7–12 tahun") dan nama provinsi dibungkus agar tidak terpotong lab_usia <- if (sempit) paste0(sub("Usia ", "", lab_pendek(V_APS)), " tahun") else paste0(lab_pendek(V_APS), " tahun") w$usia <- factor(lab_usia[match(w$var, V_APS)], levels = lab_usia) w$wilayah <- factor(w$wilayah, levels = unique(wil$wilayah)) if (sempit) levels(w$wilayah) <- vapply(levels(w$wilayah), function(s) paste(strwrap(s, 14), collapse = "\n"), "") w$tip <- paste0(w$wilayah, " · ", lab_pendek(w$var), " tahun: ", w$n, " dari 100 bersekolah") w$grup <- paste(w$wilayah, w$var) lab <- unique(w[, c("wilayah", "usia", "n")]) # setelah label disesuaikan, agar cocok dengan panel ggplot(w, aes(x, y, fill = status)) + geom_tile_i(aes(tooltip = tip, data_id = grup), colour = "#FFFFFF", linewidth = 0.4, width = 0.9, height = 0.9) + geom_text(data = lab, aes(x = 4.5, y = 10.7, label = paste0(n, " dari 100")), inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 4.2, fontface = "bold", colour = COL[["hitam"]], family = FONT) + (if (!sempit) facet_grid(wilayah ~ usia, switch = "y") else if (nzchar(prov)) facet_wrap(vars(usia, wilayah), ncol = 2) else facet_wrap(vars(usia), ncol = 2)) + coord_equal(ylim = c(-0.5, 11.4), clip = "off") + scale_fill_manual(values = COL_SEKOLAH, name = NULL) + labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) + theme_akademik(base_size = BASE_APP, grid = "none") + theme(axis.text = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(), axis.line = element_blank(), strip.text.x = element_text(hjust = 0.5, lineheight = 1), strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 1), strip.placement = "outside", strip.clip = "off") } gg_peringkat <- function(v, th, sorot = "", sempit = FALSE) { d <- data_peta(v, th); d <- d[!d$salinan & !is.na(d$nilai), ] ind <- d$indonesia[1] d$posisi <- factor(ifelse(d$selisih < 0, "Di bawah Indonesia", "Di atas Indonesia"), levels = c("Di bawah Indonesia", "Di atas Indonesia")) d$peringkat <- rank(-d$nilai, ties.method = "min") d$nama_f <- reorder(d$nama, d$nilai) d$tip <- paste0(d$nama, ": ", fmt_angka(d$nilai, 1), "% · peringkat ", d$peringkat, " dari ", nrow(d), ifelse(nzchar(d$catatan), paste0(" (", tolower(d$catatan), ")"), "")) g <- ggplot(d, aes(nilai, nama_f, colour = posisi)) + geom_vline(xintercept = ind, colour = COL[["abu_tua"]], linewidth = 0.4) + geom_segment(aes(x = ind, xend = nilai, yend = nama_f), linewidth = 0.6) + geom_point_i(aes(tooltip = tip, data_id = nama), size = 2.6) + # label "Indonesia" diletakkan di sisi garis yang lebih lapang (audit 17 Nov: terpotong di HP) annotate("text", x = ind, y = nrow(d) + 0.9, label = paste0("Indonesia ", fmt_angka(ind, 1), "%"), hjust = if (ind > mean(range(d$nilai))) 1.05 else -0.05, size = 3.4, colour = COL[["abu_tua"]], family = FONT) + scale_colour_manual(values = c("Di bawah Indonesia" = COL[["koral"]], "Di atas Indonesia" = COL[["navy"]]), name = NULL, drop = FALSE, guide = guide_legend(nrow = if (sempit) 2 else 1)) + scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"), breaks = scales::breaks_pretty(if (sempit) 3 else 5)) + # di HP angka sumbu tidak berdesakan scale_y_discrete(expand = expansion(add = c(0.6, 1.8))) + coord_cartesian(clip = "off") + labs(x = paste(strwrap(paste0(lab_awam(v), " (", th, ")"), if (sempit) 22 else 45), collapse = "\n"), y = NULL) + theme_akademik(base_size = BASE_APP, grid = "x") + theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = rel(0.85))) if (nzchar(sorot) && sorot %in% d$nama) g <- g + geom_point(data = d[d$nama == sorot, ], shape = 21, size = 5, stroke = 1.2, colour = COL[["hitam"]], fill = NA) g } gg_internet_sekolah <- function(sorot = "") { d <- PROV[PROV$tahun == 2024, ] d$kelompok <- factor(ifelse(d$kode >= 91, "6 provinsi Papua", "Provinsi lain"), levels = names(COL_PAPUA)) d$tip <- paste0(d$nama, "\nMemakai internet: ", fmt_angka(d$NET_TOTAL, 1), "%\nRemaja 16–18 bersekolah: ", fmt_angka(d$APS_16_18, 1), "%") g <- ggplot(d, aes(NET_TOTAL, APS_16_18, colour = kelompok, shape = kelompok)) + geom_point_i(aes(tooltip = tip, data_id = nama), size = 3) + scale_colour_manual(values = COL_PAPUA, name = NULL) + scale_shape_manual(values = BENTUK_PAPUA, name = NULL) + scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")) + scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")) + labs(x = "Memakai internet (2024)", y = "Remaja 16–18 bersekolah") + # ringkas: muat di HP theme_akademik(base_size = BASE_APP, grid = "xy") if (nzchar(sorot)) g <- g + geom_point(data = d[d$nama == sorot, ], shape = 21, size = 6, stroke = 1.2, colour = COL[["hitam"]], fill = NA) g } girafe_vdp <- function(g, w, h) { ggiraph::girafe(ggobj = g, width_svg = w, height_svg = h, options = list( ggiraph::opts_tooltip(css = paste0("background:#FFFFFF;color:", COL[["hitam"]], ";border:1px solid ", COL[["abu_muda"]], ";padding:6px 8px;border-radius:4px;font-family:", FONT_WEB, ";font-size:13px;"), use_fill = FALSE), ggiraph::opts_hover(css = "opacity:0.8;stroke-width:1.5px;"), ggiraph::opts_hover_inv(css = "opacity:0.35;"), ggiraph::opts_selection(type = "none"), ggiraph::opts_toolbar(saveaspng = FALSE), ggiraph::opts_sizing(rescale = TRUE))) } # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ # Grafik plotly (dinamis/interaktif/animasi): fungsi murni # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ gaya_plotly <- function(p) { p |> layout(font = list(family = FONT_WEB, size = 13, color = COL[["hitam"]]), separators = ",.", paper_bgcolor = COL[["latar"]], plot_bgcolor = COL[["latar"]], hoverlabel = list(font = list(family = FONT_WEB), bgcolor = "#FFFFFF"), # legenda di atas area grafik (yanchor bawah): bila berbaris-baris di HP, ia mendorong # margin ke atas, tidak menimpa garis (audit 17 Nov) legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0, xanchor = "left", y = 1.02, yanchor = "bottom"), margin = list(l = 55, r = 15, t = 30, b = 40)) |> config(displaylogo = FALSE, modeBarButtonsToRemove = c("lasso2d", "select2d", "autoScale2d", "toggleSpikelines", "hoverCompareCartesian", "hoverClosestCartesian")) } sumbu <- function(judul, ...) list(title = judul, gridcolor = COL[["grid"]], zeroline = FALSE, linecolor = COL[["abu"]], ...) # Sumbu tahun: di HP label tiap 2 tahun agar tidak diputar tegak (audit 17 Nov) sumbu_tahun <- function(sempit = FALSE, slider = FALSE) { s <- sumbu("", dtick = if (sempit) 2 else 1, tickformat = "d", tickangle = 0) if (slider) s$rangeslider <- list(visible = TRUE, thickness = 0.07) s } # Label langsung di ujung kanan garis (warna teks digelapkan agar kontras >= 4,5:1); # jarak minimum antarlabel mencegah tumpang-tindih label_ujung <- function(y, teks, warna, jarak = 6) { o <- order(-y); yy <- y[o] for (i in seq_along(yy)[-1]) yy[i] <- min(yy[i], yy[i - 1] - jarak) y[o] <- yy lapply(seq_along(y), function(i) list(x = 1, xref = "paper", xanchor = "left", xshift = 4, y = y[i], yref = "y", text = teks[i], showarrow = FALSE, font = list(color = warna_teks(warna[i]), size = 12))) } pandemi <- list(type = "rect", xref = "x", yref = "paper", x0 = 2019.6, x1 = 2021.4, y0 = 0, y1 = 1, fillcolor = COL[["grid"]], line = list(width = 0), layer = "below") plot_tren <- function(prov = "", sempit = FALSE) { p <- plot_ly() for (v in V_APS) { lb <- lab_pendek(v) p <- add_lines(p, x = NAS$tahun, y = NAS[[v]], name = lb, legendgroup = lb, line = list(color = COL_USIA[[lb]], width = if (v == "APS_16_18") 4 else 2), text = paste0("Indonesia · ", lb, ": ", fmt_angka(NAS[[v]], 1), "%"), hoverinfo = "text") if (nzchar(prov)) { d <- PROV[PROV$nama == prov, ] p <- add_lines(p, x = d$tahun, y = d[[v]], name = paste(lb, "·", prov), legendgroup = lb, showlegend = FALSE, line = list(color = COL_USIA[[lb]], width = 2, dash = "dash"), text = paste0(prov, " · ", lb, ": ", pct(d[[v]]), ifelse(d$CAKUPAN_LAMA_PEND, " (wilayah lama)", "")), hoverinfo = "text") } } # label langsung kelompok umur (audit 17 Nov: abu tua vs teal sulit dibedakan pada buta warna merah-hijau) akhir <- unlist(NAS[NAS$tahun == max(NAS$tahun), V_APS]) ujung <- label_ujung(akhir, sub("Usia ", "", lab_pendek(V_APS)), unname(COL_USIA[lab_pendek(V_APS)])) layout(p, xaxis = sumbu_tahun(sempit, slider = TRUE), yaxis = sumbu("Anak yang bersekolah", range = c(0, 102), ticksuffix = "%"), shapes = list(pandemi), annotations = c(list(list(x = 2020.5, y = 0.04, xref = "x", yref = "paper", text = "Pandemi", showarrow = FALSE, font = list(color = COL[["abu_tua"]], size = 11))), ujung)) |> gaya_plotly() |> layout(margin = list(r = 48), showlegend = !sempit) # di HP cukup label langsung } plot_gerak <- function(sorot = "", sempit = FALSE) { d <- PROV[!is.na(PROV$APS_13_15) & !is.na(PROV$APS_16_18), ] d$kelompok <- factor(ifelse(d$kode >= 91, "6 provinsi Papua", "Provinsi lain"), levels = names(COL_PAPUA)) d$garis <- ifelse(d$nama == sorot, 3, 0.6) d$simbol <- ifelse(d$kelompok == "6 provinsi Papua", "triangle-up", "circle") # tidak hanya warna d$tip <- paste0("", d$nama, " (", d$tahun, ")
Usia 13–15: ", fmt_angka(d$APS_13_15, 1), "%
Usia 16–18: ", fmt_angka(d$APS_16_18, 1), "%", ifelse(d$CAKUPAN_LAMA_PEND, "
wilayah lama (sebelum pemekaran)", "")) n <- NAS n$tip <- paste0("Indonesia (", n$tahun, ")
Usia 13–15: ", fmt_angka(n$APS_13_15, 1), "%
Usia 16–18: ", fmt_angka(n$APS_16_18, 1), "%") rx <- range(d$APS_13_15) + c(-1.5, 1); ry <- range(d$APS_16_18) + c(-3, 3) p <- plot_ly() # satu trace per kelompok: warna dan simbol tetap per trace (pemetaan simbol plotly tertukar saat dipecah) for (k in names(COL_PAPUA)) { dk <- d[d$kelompok == k, ] p <- add_markers(p, data = dk, x = ~APS_13_15, y = ~APS_16_18, frame = ~tahun, ids = ~nama, split = ~kelompok, text = ~tip, hoverinfo = "text", marker = list(size = 12, opacity = 0.85, color = COL_PAPUA[[k]], symbol = dk$simbol[1], line = list(width = ~garis, color = COL[["hitam"]]))) } p |> # split = nama -> legenda bernama "Indonesia" (sebelumnya tampil "trace 2") add_markers(data = n, x = ~APS_13_15, y = ~APS_16_18, frame = ~tahun, ids = ~nama, split = ~nama, text = ~tip, hoverinfo = "text", marker = list(symbol = "diamond", size = 16, color = COL[["hitam"]])) |> layout(xaxis = sumbu("Anak usia 13–15 yang bersekolah", range = rx, ticksuffix = "%"), yaxis = sumbu("Remaja usia 16–18 yang bersekolah", range = ry, ticksuffix = "%")) |> animation_opts(frame = 1000, transition = 700, redraw = FALSE) |> # tombol & penggeser tahun diberi ruang sendiri di bawah judul sumbu (audit 17 Nov: sempat bertumpuk) animation_slider(currentvalue = list(prefix = "Tahun ", xanchor = "right", font = list(color = COL[["abu_tua"]])), pad = list(t = 55, l = 75), y = 0) |> animation_button(label = "▶ Putar", x = 0, xanchor = "left", y = 0, yanchor = "top", pad = list(t = 62)) |> gaya_plotly() |> layout(margin = list(b = 115)) } plot_jarak <- function(sempit = FALSE) { p <- plot_ly() for (v in c("APS_13_15", "APS_16_18", "APS_19_23")) { lb <- lab_pendek(v); s <- D$sigma[D$sigma$var == v, ] p <- add_lines(p, x = s$tahun, y = s$sb, name = lb, line = list(color = COL_USIA[[lb]], width = if (v == "APS_16_18") 4 else 2), text = paste0(lb, ", ", s$tahun, ": jarak ", fmt_angka(s$sb, 2), " poin"), hoverinfo = "text") } layout(p, xaxis = sumbu_tahun(sempit), yaxis = sumbu("Jarak antarprovinsi (poin persen)", rangemode = "tozero")) |> gaya_plotly() } plot_internet <- function(prov = "", sempit = FALSE) { g <- D$digital p <- plot_ly() |> add_lines(x = g$tahun, y = g$desa, name = "Desa", line = list(color = COL_DAERAH[["Desa"]], width = 3), text = paste0("Desa ", g$tahun, ": ", fmt_angka(g$desa, 1), "%"), hoverinfo = "text") |> add_lines(x = g$tahun, y = g$kota, name = "Kota", fill = "tonexty", fillcolor = tint(COL[["abu_muda"]], 0.5), line = list(color = COL_DAERAH[["Kota"]], width = 3), text = paste0("Kota ", g$tahun, ": ", fmt_angka(g$kota, 1), "% · selisih ", fmt_angka(g$selisih_kota_desa, 1), " poin"), hoverinfo = "text") if (nzchar(prov)) { d <- PROV[PROV$nama == prov & PROV$tahun <= 2024, ] for (dd in list(c("NET_KOTA", "Kota"), c("NET_DESA", "Desa"))) { if (all(is.na(d[[dd[1]]]))) next p <- add_lines(p, x = d$tahun, y = d[[dd[1]]], name = paste(dd[2], prov), line = list(color = COL_DAERAH[[dd[2]]], width = 2, dash = "dash"), text = paste0(prov, " · ", tolower(dd[2]), " ", d$tahun, ": ", pct(d[[dd[1]]]), ifelse(d$CAKUPAN_LAMA_NET, " (wilayah lama)", "")), hoverinfo = "text") } } layout(p, xaxis = sumbu_tahun(sempit, slider = TRUE), yaxis = sumbu("Penduduk yang memakai internet", range = c(0, 100), ticksuffix = "%")) |> gaya_plotly() } plot_jelajah <- function(v, provs, sempit = FALSE) { p <- plot_ly() |> add_lines(x = NAS$tahun, y = NAS[[v]], name = "Indonesia", line = list(color = COL[["hitam"]], width = 4), text = paste0("Indonesia ", NAS$tahun, ": ", pct(NAS[[v]])), hoverinfo = "text") # audit 17 Nov: koral & oker mirip bagi buta warna -> tiap provinsi juga beda jenis garis; # oker digelapkan agar garis >= 3:1 terhadap latar putih warna <- c(unname(COL[c("navy", "teal", "koral", "violet")]), warna_teks(COL[["oker"]], 3)) jenis <- c("solid", "dash", "dot", "dashdot", "longdash") lama_col <- if (v %in% V_NET) "CAKUPAN_LAMA_NET" else "CAKUPAN_LAMA_PEND" for (i in seq_along(provs)) { d <- PROV[PROV$nama == provs[i], ] p <- add_lines(p, x = d$tahun, y = d[[v]], name = provs[i], line = list(color = warna[i], width = 2.5, dash = jenis[i]), text = paste0(provs[i], " ", d$tahun, ": ", pct(d[[v]]), ifelse(d[[lama_col]], " # ==============================================================================
# 00 SISTEM VISUAL BERSAMA — TUGAS AKHIR (EDM · ML · VDP)
# Dasar  : Universal_Academic_Data_Visualization_Design_System.md
#          "Satu keputusan desain -> banyak keluaran yang konsisten" (bagian 19)
# Isi    : palet semantik, tema ggplot, format angka Indonesia, penyimpan grafik
# Pakai  : source("D:/R/DATA SAINS (TUGAS AKHIR)/00_visual_system.R")
# Paket  : ggplot2, scales, ragg (PNG), systemfonts (cek font)
# ==============================================================================

library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

# 1. Palet ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Terbatas & redup: navy (utama), teal (sekunder), koral (aksen/perhatian),
# violet & oker (pendukung), abu-abu (netral). Diuji agar tetap terbedakan
# dalam skala abu-abu karena kecerahannya berbeda (navy gelap -> oker terang).
COL <- c(
  navy     = "#1B3A5C",
  teal     = "#3D8C8C",
  koral    = "#D1693F",
  violet   = "#6E5FA0",
  oker     = "#C2953A",
  hitam    = "#2B2F33",   # teks utama
  abu_tua  = "#5F6670",   # teks sekunder (subjudul, caption)
  abu      = "#9AA1AA",   # elemen pendukung / baseline
  abu_muda = "#D5D9DE",   # garis bantu
  grid     = "#ECEEF1",
  latar    = "#FFFFFF"
)

# Pemetaan semantik (WAJIB dipakai ulang di semua grafik, dashboard, Shiny).
# Satu kategori = satu warna di seluruh proyek (bagian 22).
COL_STATUS <- c("Di bawah L2" = COL[["koral"]], "L2 ke atas" = COL[["teal"]])
# EDM: kab/kota prioritas afirmasi (HLS <= Q1) = koral (perhatian), bukan = teal
COL_PRIORITAS <- c("Prioritas" = COL[["koral"]], "Bukan" = COL[["teal"]])
# EDM: model & baseline (algoritma = warna; prediktor utama = garis penuh, pembanding = putus)
COL_MODEL_EDM <- c("CART" = COL[["navy"]], "C5.0" = COL[["violet"]],
                   "Kebijakan berjalan" = COL[["oker"]], "Baseline" = COL[["abu"]])
# EDM: sisi variabel (kerangka ekologi)
COL_SISI <- c("Kondisi penduduk" = COL[["navy"]], "Wilayah" = COL[["oker"]],
              "Akses wilayah" = COL[["violet"]])

COL_MODEL <- c("XGBoost"       = COL[["navy"]],
               "Random forest" = COL[["teal"]],
               "MLP"           = COL[["violet"]],
               "Elastic net"   = COL[["oker"]],
               "Baseline"      = COL[["abu"]])
LT_MODEL  <- c("XGBoost" = "solid", "Random forest" = "longdash", "MLP" = "dashed",
               "Elastic net" = "dotdash", "Baseline" = "dotted")
NAMA_MODEL <- c(rec_xgboost = "XGBoost", rec_random_forest = "Random forest",
                rec_mlp = "MLP", rec_elastic_net = "Elastic net", baseline = "Baseline")

COL_TINGKAT <- c(siswa = COL[["navy"]], sekolah = COL[["oker"]])

# Klaster berurutan dari kemampuan terendah (K1) ke tertinggi (Kk):
# koral (perhatian) -> ... -> navy. Urutan kecerahan juga bergradasi.
pal_klaster <- function(k) {
  urut <- list(c("koral", "navy"),
               c("koral", "oker", "navy"),
               c("koral", "oker", "teal", "navy"),
               c("koral", "oker", "violet", "teal", "navy"),
               c("koral", "oker", "violet", "teal", "navy", "abu_tua"))
  setNames(unname(COL[urut[[k - 1]]]), paste0("K", seq_len(k)))
}

# Divergen (z-score, selisih): koral (negatif) - putih - navy (positif)
DIV_RENDAH <- COL[["koral"]]; DIV_TENGAH <- "#F7F7F5"; DIV_TINGGI <- COL[["navy"]]

# Warna teks di atas sel berwarna: putih bila latar gelap, hitam bila terang
# (luminans relatif WCAG; ambang 0,18 ~ titik kontras seimbang hitam/putih).
warna_kontras <- function(fill) {
  rgb <- grDevices::col2rgb(fill) / 255
  lin <- ifelse(rgb <= 0.03928, rgb / 12.92, ((rgb + 0.055) / 1.055)^2.4)
  lum <- 0.2126 * lin[1, ] + 0.7152 * lin[2, ] + 0.0722 * lin[3, ]
  ifelse(lum < 0.18, COL[["latar"]], COL[["hitam"]])
}
# Warna sel divergen untuk nilai x dengan batas simetris ±lim (sama dengan skala)
warna_divergen <- function(x, lim) {
  scales::div_gradient_pal(DIV_RENDAH, DIV_TENGAH, DIV_TINGGI)(scales::rescale(x, c(0, 1), c(-lim, lim)))
}

# 2. Font -----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Satu keluarga font, dukungan Unicode baik, aman untuk PDF (cairo) & PNG (ragg).
pilih_font <- function(kandidat = c("Segoe UI", "Calibri", "Arial")) {
  if (requireNamespace("systemfonts", quietly = TRUE)) {
    ada <- unique(systemfonts::system_fonts()$family)
    f <- kandidat[kandidat %in% ada]
    if (length(f)) return(f[1])
  }
  "sans"
}
FONT <- pilih_font()

# 3. Tema -----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Hierarki: judul (tebal, terbesar) > subjudul (abu tua) > judul sumbu >
# label tick > anotasi > caption. Latar putih, grid tipis horizontal saja.
theme_akademik <- function(base_size = 9.5, grid = "y", legend = "top") {
  g <- theme_minimal(base_size = base_size, base_family = FONT) +
    theme(
      text               = element_text(colour = COL[["hitam"]]),
      plot.background    = element_rect(fill = COL[["latar"]], colour = NA),
      panel.background   = element_rect(fill = COL[["latar"]], colour = NA),
      plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold", size = rel(1.25), hjust = 0,
                                        margin = margin(b = 3)),
      plot.subtitle      = element_text(colour = COL[["abu_tua"]], size = rel(0.98),
                                        lineheight = 1.15, margin = margin(b = 10)),
      plot.caption       = element_text(colour = COL[["abu_tua"]], size = rel(0.78),
                                        hjust = 0, lineheight = 1.15, margin = margin(t = 10)),
      plot.title.position   = "plot",
      plot.caption.position = "plot",
      plot.margin        = margin(12, 14, 10, 12),
      axis.title         = element_text(colour = COL[["abu_tua"]], size = rel(0.92)),
      axis.title.x       = element_text(margin = margin(t = 6)),
      axis.title.y       = element_text(margin = margin(r = 6)),
      axis.text          = element_text(colour = COL[["hitam"]], size = rel(0.88)),
      axis.ticks         = element_line(colour = COL[["abu_muda"]], linewidth = 0.3),
      axis.ticks.length  = unit(2.5, "pt"),
      axis.line          = element_line(colour = COL[["abu"]], linewidth = 0.35),
      panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major   = element_line(colour = COL[["grid"]], linewidth = 0.35),
      strip.text         = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0, size = rel(0.95),
                                        margin = margin(b = 4, t = 2)),
      strip.background   = element_blank(),
      panel.spacing      = unit(14, "pt"),
      legend.position    = legend,
      legend.justification = "left",
      legend.location    = "plot",          # legenda rata kiri dengan judul
      legend.title       = element_text(colour = COL[["abu_tua"]], size = rel(0.88)),
      legend.text        = element_text(size = rel(0.88)),
      legend.key.width   = unit(18, "pt"),
      legend.margin      = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
      legend.box.spacing = unit(4, "pt")
    )

  g
}

# Ukuran teks anotasi geom_text/annotate (mm) yang selaras dengan tema
TXT_ANOT <- 2.9

# 4. Format angka Indonesia ------------------------------------------------------
# Desimal koma, ribuan titik. Dipakai di sumbu, label, tooltip, dan tabel.
fmt_angka  <- function(x, digit = 2) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = digit,
                                              big.mark = ".", decimal.mark = ",")
fmt_bulat  <- function(x) formatC(round(x), format = "d", big.mark = ".", decimal.mark = ",")
fmt_persen <- function(x, digit = 1, skala = 1) paste0(fmt_angka(x * skala, digit), "%")
fmt_p      <- function(p) ifelse(p < 0.001, "< 0,001", fmt_angka(p, 3))

# Untuk scale_*_continuous(labels = ...). digit = NULL -> presisi otomatis dari
# jarak antar-break (mencegah label menyesatkan, mis. break 0,25 tertulis "0,2").
lab_angka  <- function(digit = NULL) label_number(accuracy = if (is.null(digit)) NULL else 10^-digit,
                                                  big.mark = ".", decimal.mark = ",")
lab_persen <- function(digit = 0, skala = 100) label_percent(accuracy = 10^-digit, scale = skala,
                                                             big.mark = ".", decimal.mark = ",")

# 5. Caption standar --------------------------------------------------------------
caption_sumber <- function(sumber, catatan = NULL) {
  paste0(if (!is.null(catatan)) paste0("Catatan: ", catatan, "\n") else "",
         "Sumber: ", sumber)
}

# 6. Pembungkus teks panjang ---------------------------------------------------------
# Judul/subjudul/caption dibungkus otomatis sesuai lebar gambar akhir agar tidak
# terpotong (Visual QA bagian 28: clipping). Baris "\n" yang disengaja dipertahankan.
bungkus <- function(x, n) {
  if (is.null(x) || !is.character(x) || !length(x)) return(x)
  baris <- strsplit(x, "\n", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  paste(vapply(baris, function(b) paste(strwrap(b, n), collapse = "\n"), ""), collapse = "\n")
}
# Perkiraan lebar karakter Segoe UI pada ukuran tema (cm/karakter), diukur dari render
CM_PER_KAR <- c(title = 0.215, subtitle = 0.16, caption = 0.12)
n_kar <- function(lebar_cm, jenis) floor((lebar_cm - 1.2) / CM_PER_KAR[[jenis]])

rapikan_teks <- function(p, lebar_cm) {
  if (!inherits(p, "ggplot") || inherits(p, "patchwork")) return(p)
  lb <- tryCatch(ggplot2::get_labs(p), error = function(e) p$labels)
  baru <- list()
  for (j in names(CM_PER_KAR)) {
    if (!is.null(lb[[j]]) && is.character(lb[[j]]))
      baru[[j]] <- bungkus(lb[[j]], n_kar(lebar_cm, j))
  }
  if (length(baru)) p + do.call(labs, baru) else p
}

# 7. Penyimpan grafik --------------------------------------------------------------
# Ukuran dipilih dari tata letak laporan A4 (lebar teks ±16 cm), bukan default.
# PDF (vektor, cairo) untuk naskah; PNG 300 dpi (ragg) untuk Word/web/Shiny.
UKURAN <- list(penuh = c(16, 10), penuh_tinggi = c(16, 13), lebar = c(16, 7.5),
               setengah = c(8, 7))

simpan_grafik <- function(p, nama, folder, ukuran = "penuh", lebar = NULL, tinggi = NULL,
                          pdf = TRUE) {
  wh <- UKURAN[[ukuran]]
  if (!is.null(lebar))  wh[1] <- lebar
  if (!is.null(tinggi)) wh[2] <- tinggi
  p <- rapikan_teks(p, wh[1])
  dev_png <- if (requireNamespace("ragg", quietly = TRUE)) ragg::agg_png else "png"
  ggsave(file.path(folder, paste0(nama, ".png")), p, width = wh[1], height = wh[2],
         units = "cm", dpi = 300, device = dev_png, bg = COL[["latar"]])
  if (pdf) ggsave(file.path(folder, paste0(nama, ".pdf")), p, width = wh[1], height = wh[2],
                  units = "cm", device = cairo_pdf, bg = COL[["latar"]])
  cat("  tersimpan:", nama, sprintf("(%.0f x %.0f cm)\n", wh[1], wh[2]))
  invisible(p)
}

# Kontras WCAG (audit desain 17 Nov): rasio kontras dua warna, dan versi warna yang digelapkan
# (dicampur dengan COL hitam) sampai mencapai rasio minimum terhadap latar putih.
# Teks berwarna (label langsung) >= 4,5:1 (WCAG 1.4.3); garis/titik data >= 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11).
rasio_kontras <- function(a, b = "#FFFFFF") {
  lum <- function(h) { r <- grDevices::col2rgb(h) / 255
    l <- ifelse(r <= 0.03928, r / 12.92, ((r + 0.055) / 1.055)^2.4)
    0.2126 * l[1, ] + 0.7152 * l[2, ] + 0.0722 * l[3, ] }
  la <- lum(a); lb <- lum(b); (pmax(la, lb) + 0.05) / (pmin(la, lb) + 0.05)
}
warna_teks <- function(col, min_rasio = 4.5) {
  vapply(unname(col), function(x) {
    for (t in seq(0, 1, by = 0.02)) {
      y <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(c(x, COL[["hitam"]]))(101)[round(t * 100) + 1]

    }
    COL[["hitam"]]
  }, "", USE.NAMES = FALSE)
